comparison.objective: Elicit a knee-jerk response with a reflex hammer and put the hammer down.
comparison.physical_skill: Aim and swing a hand tool at controlled speed, make brief face-first contact, and lift off promptly.
comparison.success_condition: Correct tendon strike produces a measurable kick; hammer then released safely; wrong location/tool face or prolonged press fails.
comparison.reason: Dynamic striking and rebound timing do not overlap meaningfully with granular separation.
